title: lycopodium cuatrecasasii
intro: Lycopodium cuatrecasasii, commonly known as Cuatrecasas's club moss, is a rare and endangered species of fern in the family Lycopodiaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the group of lycophytes, characterized by its small, club-shaped sporophylls. The plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis, and skin conditions, like eczema. The bioactive constituents of Lycopodium cuatrecasasii include alkaloids, particularly lycodine, which is believed to possess anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory properties, and can be used to treat various conditions due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
